content: The attr linkifier on this Zulip instance links to Lean 3 docs for lean 3 attributes, which are sometimes the same as lean 4 attributes. Example: attr#ext . Should we just delete this linkifier or is there a way to point it to lean 4 attribute documentation? I don't recall this linkifier being used much, at least recently.
We have tactic3 and tpil3 so I've changed it to attr3.
